saveStatus.$description: SaveStatus's component tokens. Each one is an optional override: set the CSS variable (--save-status-<name>) on the page, a container or one SaveStatus, and every SaveStatus inside follows. Unset, it uses the shared token it references here; tools/test/foundation.mjs checks that bundle.css uses exactly these defaults.

text.$description: The text and the ring (4.5:1 on the page).

error.$description: The error's icon, text and Try again (4.5:1 on the page).

gap.$description: Space between the icon, the text and Try again (6px).
